answer: Before the bottling the quillkeeper settles at the nibbench, tests the dip on the way and fills the pot as the evening deepens. The penworkshop rests on Resin reed penmaker inkshop writ: a writ reed penmakers pour twice inkshop iron tallies hold. The pearl seats the stopper, the pulse steeps the gall, the relic fills the pot. A counterfeit stopper needs 52981 copied stoppers and 52981 copied inkhorns before the ink dries.
